an5.28:1.1: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa bhāvanaṃ desessāmi
an5.28:2.1: katamā ca bhikkhave ariyassa pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa bhāvanā
an5.28:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an5.28:2.3: so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pitisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
an5.28:2.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhāniyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya sāyaṃ nhāniyapiṇḍi sinehānugatā sinehaparetā samantarabāhirā phuṭā sinehena na ca paggharati
an5.28:2.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati
an5.28:2.6: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
an5.28:2.7: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ paṭhamā bhāvanā.
an5.28:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an5.28:3.2: so imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati
an5.28:3.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
an5.28:3.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakarahado ubbhitodako tassa nevassa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ na pacchimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ na uttarāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ na dakkhiṇāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ devo ca kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ nānuppaveccheyya
an5.28:3.5: athakho tamhā ca udakarahadā sītā vāridhārā ubbhijjitvā tameva udakarahadaṃ sītena vārinā abhisandeyya parisandeyya paripūreyya paripphareyya nāssa kiñci sabbāvato udakarahadassa sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa
an5.28:3.6: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati
an5.28:3.7: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
an5.28:3.8: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ dutiyā bhāvanā.
an5.28:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an5.28:4.2: so imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati
an5.28:4.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
an5.28:4.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni
an5.28:4.5: tāni yāva caggā yāva ca mūlā sītena vārinā abhisannāni parisannāni paripūrāni paripphuṭāni
an5.28:4.6: nāssa kiñci sabbāvataṃ uppalānaṃ vā padumānaṃ vā puṇḍarīkānaṃ vā sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa
an5.28:4.7: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati
an5.28:4.8: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
an5.28:4.9: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ tatiyā bhāvanā.
an5.28:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an5.28:5.2: so imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti
an5.28:5.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti
an5.28:5.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso odātena vatthena sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisinno assa
an5.28:5.5: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa odātena vatthena apphuṭaṃ assa
an5.28:5.6: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti
an5.28:5.7: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti
an5.28:5.8: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ catutthā bhāvanā.
an5.28:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇānimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya
an5.28:6.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave añño vā aññaṃ paccavekkheyya ṭhito vā nisinnaṃ paccavekkheyya nisinno vā nipannaṃ paccavekkheyya
an5.28:6.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇānimittaṃ suggataṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya
an5.28:6.4: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ pañcamā bhāvanā.
an5.28:7.1: evaṃ bhāvite kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariye paccaṅgike sammāsamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.28:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakamaṇiko ādhāre ṭhapito pūro udakassa samatittiko kākapeyyo
an5.28:8.2: tamenaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āvaṭṭeyya āgaccheyya udakanti.
an5.28:8.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ bhāvite ariye pañcaṅgike sammāsamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.28:9.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave same bhūmibhāge pokkharaṇī caturassā ālibaddhā pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā
an5.28:9.2: tamenaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āliṃ muñceyya āgaccheyya udakanti.
an5.28:9.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ bhāvite ariye pañcaṅgike sammāsamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.28:10.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave subhūmiyaṃ cātummahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito osatapatodo
an5.28:10.2: tamenaṃ dakkho yoggācariyo assadammasārathi abhirūhitvā vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā yenicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyyapi paccāsāreyyapi
an5.28:10.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ bhāvite ariye pañcaṅgike sammāsamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya
an5.28:10.4: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.28:11.1: so sace ākaṅkhati anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ ekopi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ …pe… yāvabrahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyanti
an5.28:11.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.28:12.1: so sace ākaṅkhati dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya …pe… ye dūre santike cāti
an5.28:12.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.28:13.1: so sace ākaṅkhati parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ
an5.28:13.2: sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.28:13.17: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyyanti
an5.28:13.18: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.28:14.1: so sace ākaṅkhati anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyaṃ seyyathīdaṃ ekaṃpi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyanti
an5.28:14.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.28:15.1: so sace ākaṅkhati dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammupage satte pajāneyyanti
an5.28:15.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
an5.28:16.1: so sace ākaṅkhati āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyanti
an5.28:16.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyataneti.
